rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when things are physically separated or split apart.

example.jyutping: di1 man4 gin6 fan1 hoi1 zo2

rows.note: Use this when a group, country, or community is disunited.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gwok3 gaa1 ji5 ging1 fan1 lit6 laa3

rows.note: Use this when people or groups have conflicting opinions, interests, or feelings.

example.english: We are divided over this issue.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 jau5 fan1 kei4
